Name: Craft Anywhere - Use Materials from Chests and Storage
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
This mod is requested by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Jangko11]Jangko11[/url], thanks for idea! :3


[size=5][b][center]Craft Anywhere[/center][/b][/size][center][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][/center]
Tired of running back to your shed because you forgot one Iron Bar? Sick of sorting through twenty different chests just to find that one specific mineral?

[b]Craft Anywhere[/b] is a Quality of Life mod that gives you access to your entire inventory from everywhere. It seamlessly updates the vanilla Crafting Menu (and the Workbench) to include materials from every single chest, fridge, and storage container in your save file.

You can now craft anything, anywhere, as long as you own the materials.

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41499/41499-1768969969-1912026731.gif[/img]﻿[/center]

[size=4][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Global Crafting:[/b] Access materials from any location while crafting. You don't need to be on the farm.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Universal Storage Support:[/b] Works with standard Chests, Stone Chests, Big Chests, and Dressers.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Kitchen Integration:[/b] Pulls ingredients from your Farm House Fridge and Island Fridge automatically.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Automation Compatible:[/b] Pulls items from Auto-Grabbers, Junimo Huts, and Mills.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Seamless Integration:[/b] Works directly within the standard game menu (Press E -> Crafting Tab). No new hotkeys or menus to learn.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Performance Optimized:[/b] Scans inventories intelligently to ensure no lag, even with hundreds of chests.
[/list]
[center][youtube]PRt8oAMRHqY[/youtube]﻿[/center][list]
[/list][size=4][b]How It Works
[/b][/size]
When you open your crafting menu (or use a Workbench), the mod scans the entire world for containers you own. It effectively turns the whole world into one giant Workbench.

You can view available recipes based on your global inventory immediately. The items will be consumed from the respective chests automatically when you craft.

[size=4][b]Installation
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.
[*]Works in Single Player.
[*]Should work in Multiplayer (if installed by the player crafting).
[*]Compatible with most custom item mods.
[/list]
